name: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana-Developing Caste Welfare
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to ₹1,20,000/- for house construction.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC)/ Economically Backward Class (EBC) or Nomadic Exempted Caste. - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must have a total annual family income not exceeding ₹6,00,000/-. - The applicant must have legal ownership of land or a valid allotment order for the construction of a house.
